description: mailbox.rs lines 726 and 742: when onDestroyRemoveEmails=true and the backend returns BackendSetError::SetError for a cascade email destroy or un-mailbox patch, the handler silently continues (empty arm with no comment). RFC 8621 §2.5 says emails that are in no other mailbox MUST be destroyed. A backend returning Forbidden or another semantic error causes the mailbox to be destroyed while its emails remain. The empty arm looks like a missing error handler — a contributor reviewing this will not know if it was intentional. If intentional, needs a comment; if not, needs proper error surfacing.
title: Mailbox/set cascade: RFC MUST 'emails MUST be destroyed' silently swallowed on SetError
